structured_output.summary: Harden reverse_proxy upgraded-stream handling across reloads: opt-in detached streams, stream logging options, hijack-safe handler chain, h2 extended CONNECT, stream metrics, config exposure, and tests.

intents.text: Add an opt-in reverse_proxy setting `stream_detached` so that, when set, upgraded streams are detached from the config lifecycle, survive a reload, and on reload only streams whose upstream was removed from the new config are closed.
Keep the default (stream_detached unset) behaviour unchanged: upgraded streams are closed on reload, honouring the existing close-delay behaviour.

Add a `stream_logs` block with a `skip_handshake` option (default: handshake logged) that suppresses access logging of the upgrade handshake, and emit stream close logs available in the access log via `logger_name access`, with a configurable log level defaulting to DEBUG.

Ensure upgraded streams work through other handlers in the route (`encode`, `intercept` with `handle_response`, access logging): after a connection is hijacked nothing writes to the response again, 101 is treated as the final response, and the proxy copies bytes on the raw connection rather than through the recording response writer.
Keep HTTP/2 extended CONNECT (RFC 8441) upgrades working, and HTTP/1.1 upgrades working in detached mode.
Add reverse_proxy stream metrics for active streams, streams closed by result, stream duration, and bytes to and from the backend, with each stream accounted exactly once.
Expose the new options in both Caddyfile and JSON config and document them.

Add integration tests in caddytest/integration running a real server and real clients covering: streams surviving and being closed across reloads in each mode, extended CONNECT over h2, upgrades through `encode` and `intercept`, and detached streams with access logging.
Add unit tests for the pieces changed.

constraints: Default behaviour for upgraded streams on reload must remain as today (close, honouring close delay).
Existing test suites must stay green.
Follow AGENTS.md rules (no new dependencies without justification, no exported external types, cross-platform).
